demo.code:
# Who launched this coin, and how did their other coins end? ($0.01, first 5 calls a day free)
bankr agent "Using the groundtruth skill, pull GCyzQVvCqHvE2pgAmKamDaZwL4rnT6QyuUG96fYYpump"

# The dev's count ($0.01)
bankr agent "Using the groundtruth skill, how many coins has this dev launched and rugged: <wallet>"

# Before you buy
bankr agent "Using the groundtruth skill, check this CA and show me the dev's rug count"

setup: No install required: two plain HTTP GETs behind x402 v2 (USDC, $0.01 a call, Base or Solana)
/v1/record?ca= (coin) and /v1/flag?addr= (dev) serve 5 free calls a day per IP, then 402
Read-only. Counts only: it never calls a coin safe
